quotes.author: Candace M
quotes.text: We loved our morning tour of San Fran, Muir Woods and Sausalito. Michael was our guide and he was extremely informative about the city. I learned so much! Muir Woods was quite chilly in the morning but we had the perfect amount of time to walk quite a bit and visit the gift shop. It was nice and quiet in the woods. The drive there was also interesting. Sausalito is very pretty and has a lot of cute shops. On the way back we stopped at a fort for a unique view of the bridge and had a few minutes to take pictures. I really appreciated that we were picked up and dropped off at our hotel too.

quotes.author: Anthony R
quotes.text: This was a fantastic tour! Buddy, our tour guide was fabulous! He was very knowledgeable and told many stories and gave so much information about the countless sights on the city tour. We stopped at several notable landmarks for pictures and Buddy was very accommodating for everyone’s comfort level once off the bus for photos. We highly recommend this half day tour of the city for everyone.

quotes.author: MARTIN S
quotes.text: Michael was an awesome tour guide. He was very engaging and knowledgeable about the areas we toured. The Muir woods were a highlight in a great trip to SF. I would highly recommend touring them. Michael went out of his way to skip the Golden Gate Bridge at the beginning due to very thick fog and circled back to it later so we could get decent pictures. Overall it was a great day!

quotes.author: Rob D
quotes.text: We 4 seniors got this tour to ourselves with Kyril in a Lincoln Navigator.! His knowledge and obvious love of the city was excellent and informative and he showed us things we would never have found ourselves. His humorous narrative was very entertaining and we all felt we had been treted to a special experience. Would highly recommend

quotes.author: Nikki L
quotes.text: My husband and I decided to do a tour because we didn’t have a car. This was a great decision because Randy was an amazing tour guide! We were in a minivan with 3 other people and it was perfect. We learned so much , and had a great time. Muir Woods is breathtaking and Sausalito is adorable. I highly recommend this tour.

quotes.author: Tina D
quotes.text: We had an amazing day sightseeing with Kyrill. Extremely informative, funny and friendly. We saw so much of San Francisco with great attention given to detail. Stops for photos. All in all an excellent experience and we would highly recommend. Loved the Lincoln navigator. So comfortable and clean.
